title: Attention Is All You Need: Revisited
summary: We revisit the transformer architecture and propose several improvements that significantly reduce training time while maintaining model quality on standard benchmarks.

title: Scaling Language Models: Methods, Analysis and Insights from Training Gopher
summary: We present an analysis of large language model training dynamics, focusing on the relationship between model size, dataset size, and compute budget for optimal performance.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: We explore how chain-of-thought prompting, where a few chain of thought demonstrations are provided as exemplars in prompting, can substantially boost the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning.
